# Example of file type validation in Rails
def valid_image?(file)
  accepted_formats = %w[image/jpeg image/png image/gif]
  accepted_formats.include?(file.content_type)
end

# Usage
file = params[:file]
if valid_image?(file)
  # Proceed with upload
else
  render json: { error: 'Unsupported file format' }, status: :bad_request
end
